description: Flood, water extent and rainfall products: Syria is a data set listed in Humanitarian Data Exchange, an open data portal, published or maintained by OCHA Türkiye (inactive). On 26 December 2018, exceptionally heavy rainfall caused severe flash flooding in Idleb and Aleppo governorates in north-west Syria. This area has a high proportion of displaced people and concentration of camps and sites, making it a region with a notably large vulnerable population. Coverage: Syria. The portal files it under the publisher OCHA Türkiye (inactive). Its tags are education, flooding, needs assessment, populated places-settlements. It offers 2 resource(s) in PDF, XLSX. The portal shows 2019-02-06 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Public Domain / No restrictions (CC0). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard and risk assessment. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-hdx-humanitarian-data-exchange.
